video.note: Generated by `benchmark_pipeline_extraction.py --prepare-fixtures`, never committed (*.mp4 is git-ignored). Encoded bytes depend on the OpenCV/FFmpeg build: copy the reference file between hosts so fixture checksums stay identical.
video.pacing: file source: unpaced, every-frame semantics (decoded as fast as the pipeline consumes)
video.reference_encoder: opencv-python 4.10.0 (bundled FFmpeg mpeg4 via mp4v), macOS arm64, Python 3.12; regenerated twice with identical bytes

generator.description: Horizontal/vertical pan over a panorama of committed test images resized to 1280x850; frame i crops x=(i*step_x) mod (panorama_width-width), y=triangle wave of (i*step_y) over (panorama_height-height).

detection_workflow.json.purpose: CPU/numpy baseline: object detection only; override model_id with --model-id (registry id or local package directory).

tensor_workflow.json.purpose: Tensor-mode baseline: detection plus a tensor-native dynamic crop (crops are computed but not output, so no image serialisation) and a detections count. Avoids image-property operations that read numpy_image and would copy GPU frames to host.

model_packages.note: Loaded without credentials via ALLOW_INFERENCE_MODELS_DIRECTLY_ACCESS_LOCAL_PACKAGES=True and --model-id <package directory>. Paths are host-specific and stay out of fixtures; results record per-file SHA256 of the package used.

l4-yolov8-trt.backend: TensorRT FP16 as reported by the coordinator; results record the package's model_config.json fields
